content.text: {"id": "mm7206a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "2021 data indicate an increase in suicide to 48,183, nearly returning to the 2018 peak (48,344)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Suicide rates among persons aged 10–24 years increased significantly during 2018–2021 among Black persons"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "Annual number of suicides and rates of suicide* (suicides per 100,000 population)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Age-adjusted 2021 suicide rates were highest among non-Hispanic American Indian or Alaska Native (AI/AN) persons (28.1 per 100,000) overall"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "from 22.3 to 28.1 per 100,000; a 26% increase"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among those aged 25–44 years, rates increased significantly overall (5%) and among AI/AN (33.7%)"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Age-adjusted rates (suicides per 100,000 population) were calculated using the direct method and the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau standard population."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Suicides were identified from the National Vital Statistics System multiple cause-of-death mortality files for 2018–2021."}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Differences in rates from 2018 to 2021 were compared using z-tests when deaths were ≥100"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Age-adjusted rates and 95% CIs were calculated using the direct method and the 2000 U.S. standard population."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Differences in rates from 2018 to 2021 were compared using z-tests when deaths were ≥100"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "When deaths were <100, differences in rates were considered significant if CIs based on a gamma distribution did not overlap."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Z-tests were used if the number of deaths was ≥100"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
